entries.prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL ultrawide 21:9 illustration, requested 2560x1080, for a dark Norse website. Medium: unmistakably DRAWN, bold graphic screenprint / hand-inked fantasy poster. Strong black contour lines, deliberate stylized anatomy, simplified large flat color shapes, decorative flowing ink strokes, limited palette, two-tone cel shading, sparse stipple. NOT realistic: no photorealism, no 3D, no physically rendered light/materials, no realistic fur/feather texture, no metallic volumetric engraving. Mostly pure BLACK background and negative space, art fills central/right region with some free left area. Nordic animal-interlace and braided knot motifs integrated sparingly. No landscape behind subjects, no mountains/forest/lake backdrop. No words, captions, stock marks, watermark, border or copied reference composition. Attached images are inspiration for subject/style only, create new artwork, do not reproduce or edit the stock art. Subject: Huginn and Muninn, two black ravens in opposed sweeping flight, their broad angular wings making a bold asymmetric emblem. Very graphic slate-blue and ivory feather SHAPES, limited antique-gold lines, ink splatter dissolving at wing tips. An incomplete knotted ring behind them, isolated on pure black. Reference 1 dictates flat graphic poster treatment; reference 2 supplies only the idea of two birds dissolving into ink, not its realism or landscape.
entries.exportProcessing: Main-subject 16:9 crop and Lanczos upscale; nativeSize records the original generation.
